examples.en: I set two alarms to wake me up in the morning.
examples.zh: 我設了兩個鬧鐘在早晨叫醒我。

examples.en: My alarm clock rings loudly at six thirty every morning.
examples.zh: 我的鬧鐘每天早上六點半都會大聲響起。

examples.en: She woke up immediately when the fire alarm sounded throughout the hallway.
examples.zh: 當走廊各處響起火災警報時，她立刻驚醒了過來。

examples.en: He forgot to set his alarm and consequently missed the early morning briefing.
examples.zh: 他忘記設鬧鐘，結果錯過了清晨的簡報會議。

examples.en: Modern security infrastructures integrate sophisticated sensor alarms to preempt unauthorized perimeter breaches.
examples.zh: 現代安防基礎設施整合了尖端感測警報系統，以預先防範未經授權的邊界入侵。

examples.en: Let's go straight back home after the potluck party tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚百樂餐會結束後，我們就直接回家吧。

examples.en: Walk straight along this road and you will see the convenience store.
examples.zh: 沿著這條路直走，你就會看到便利商店。

examples.en: After finishing work, he went straight to the hospital to visit his sick friend.
examples.zh: 下班後，他直接前往醫院探望生病的朋友。

examples.en: The manager asked him to be straight with the team about the upcoming schedule changes.
examples.zh: 經理要求他就即將到來的日程變動向團隊坦誠說明。

examples.en: Engineering leads must address critical database concurrency anomalies straight away to prevent system failure.
examples.zh: 工程主管必須立即處理關鍵的資料庫並發異常，以防系統崩潰。

examples.en: You'll need to do some serious research before you start writing your report.
examples.zh: 在你開始寫報告之前，將需要做些認真的研究。

examples.en: The students spent the afternoon conducting online research in the library.
examples.zh: 學生們整個下午都在圖書館進行線上資料研究。

examples.en: Recent market research indicates that consumer demand for electric vehicles is rising rapidly.
examples.zh: 近期的市場研究顯示，消費者對電動車的需求正迅速攀升。

examples.en: Scientific research has proven that regular exercise helps reduce stress and improve sleep.
examples.zh: 科學研究已證實，規律運動有助於減輕壓力並改善睡眠品質。

examples.en: Comprehensive empirical research provides rigorous justification for structural economic policy adjustments.
examples.zh: 詳盡的實證研究為結構性經濟政策調整提供了嚴謹的依據支持。

examples.en: Joanna stayed up late studying for the exam. Therefore, she overslept the next morning.
examples.zh: Joanna 為了考試熬夜唸書；因此，她隔天早上睡過頭了。

examples.en: I was afraid I would oversleep, so I set three different timers.
examples.zh: 我擔心自己會睡過頭，所以設了三個不同的鬧鈴。

examples.en: Because Tom overslept, he had to take a taxi to make it to the interview.
examples.zh: 因為 Tom 睡過頭了，他不得不搭計程車趕去面試。

examples.en: Irregular resting schedules frequently cause college students to oversleep on weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 不規律的作息常導致大學生在平日早晨睡過頭。

examples.en: Chronic physiological exhaustion invariably predisposes shift operators to oversleep, necessitating rotational schedule adjustments.
examples.zh: 長期的生理耗損必然使輪班作業員容易睡過頭，亟需調整輪班作息機制。

examples.en: This restaurant doesn't look fancy at all, but its food is amazing.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳看起來一點也不豪華，但它的食物令人驚艷。

examples.en: We saw an amazing sunset over the ocean during our weekend trip.
examples.zh: 在週末旅行中，我們在海邊看到了令人驚嘆的日落景色。

examples.en: The magician performed an amazing series of card tricks that baffled the audience.
examples.zh: 魔術師表演了一連串令人稱奇的撲克牌魔術，令觀眾百思不得其解。

examples.en: It is amazing how rapidly renewable energy technology has progressed over the past decade.
examples.zh: 令人驚奇的是，再生能源科技在過去十年間取得了如此迅速的進展。

examples.en: The research facility achieved an amazing milestone in quantum computational error correction.
examples.zh: 該研究機構在量子計算錯誤修正領域取得了一項令人矚目的突破性里程碑。

examples.en: A Taiwanese-American, Peter Tsai, invented N95 masks.
examples.zh: 一位台裔美國人 Peter Tsai 發明了 N95 口罩。

examples.en: Thomas Edison is famous because he invented many useful devices.
examples.zh: 湯瑪斯·愛迪生聞名於世，因為他發明了許多實用的裝置。

examples.en: Engineers continually invent new software algorithms to streamline mobile communications.
examples.zh: 工程師們不斷發明新的軟體演算法，以簡化行動通訊流程。

examples.en: He did not tell the truth and instead invented an excuse for his absence.
examples.zh: 他沒有說出實情，反而捏造了一個缺席的藉口。

examples.en: Pioneering biomedical scientists strive to invent therapeutic modalities targeting genetic disorders.
examples.zh: 開創性的生物醫學家致力於研發針對遺傳性疾病的全新治療模式。

examples.en: Can you believe that I spent the whole day trying to solve a computer problem?
examples.zh: 你敢相信嗎？我花了一整天的時間，就為了試著解決一個電腦問題！

examples.en: The teacher showed the students how to solve the difficult math equation.
examples.zh: 老師向學生示範如何解出這道困難的數學方程式。

examples.en: Effective communication between departments helped solve the scheduling conflict quickly.
examples.zh: 跨部門間的有效溝通協助迅速解決了排程上的衝突。

examples.en: The technical support team worked tirelessly to solve the network outage across the branch offices.
examples.zh: 技術支援團隊不知疲倦地工作，以解決各分公司的網路中斷問題。

examples.en: Advanced computational intelligence can efficiently solve multi-variable logistical optimization models.
examples.zh: 先進的計算智慧能夠高效率地求解多變數物流最佳化模型。

examples.en: Jessica likes to drink soy milk more than regular cow's milk.
examples.zh: Jessica 喜歡喝豆漿勝過一般的牛奶。

examples.en: Maintaining regular sleeping habits is essential for your body and mind.
examples.zh: 維持規律的睡眠習慣對你的身心靈都至關重要。

examples.en: He has been a regular customer at this local cafe for over five years.
examples.zh: 五年多來，他一直是這家在地咖啡館的常客。

examples.en: Vehicle mechanics recommend regular engine oil checks to prevent unexpected road breakdowns.
examples.zh: 汽車技師建議進行定期的機油檢查，以防止行車時發生突發故障。

examples.en: Institutional auditing protocols require regular internal compliance verifications to mitigate fiduciary risks.
examples.zh: 機構稽核規範要求定期執行內部合規查核，以減低受託信託風險。

examples.en: The dog stopped chasing after the mailman when its master showed up and shouted at it.
examples.zh: 當主人出現並對牠大喊時，那隻狗才停止追趕郵差。

examples.en: Children love to chase colorful butterflies around the park in the spring.
examples.zh: 春天時，孩子們喜歡在公園裡到處追逐彩色的蝴蝶。

examples.en: The police patrol car had to chase the reckless speeding driver through the dark streets.
examples.zh: 警方巡邏車不得不穿過漆黑的街道追捕那輛危險超速的車輛。

examples.en: Young graduates should pursue their passions rather than blindly chasing short-term monetary gains.
examples.zh: 年輕畢業生應當追求自己的熱情，而非盲目追逐短期的金錢利益。

examples.en: Global venture capital firms relentlessly chase disruptive technological startups to capture asymmetric yields.
examples.zh: 全球創投機構不懈地追逐具顛覆性的科技新創，以獲取不對稱的超額回報。

examples.en: John promised that he would finish the job by Friday.
examples.zh: John 答應會在週五前把工作完成。

examples.en: I promise I will return your novel as soon as I finish the final chapter.
examples.zh: 我保證一讀完最後一章就立刻把小說還給你。

examples.en: The supplier promised prompt delivery of the critical components before the factory opened.
examples.zh: 供應商承諾會在工廠開工前準時交付關鍵零組件。

examples.en: Politicians often make ambitious promises during election campaigns that prove difficult to fulfill.
examples.zh: 政治人物在競選活動期間常做出雄心勃勃的承諾，但事後證明往往難以兌現。

examples.en: Legally binding bilateral accords promise reciprocal trade liberalizations across cross-border financial sectors.
examples.zh: 具法律約束力的雙邊協議承諾在跨境金融領域落實互惠貿易自由化。

examples.en: The teacher asked the students to design their own business cards.
examples.zh: 老師要求學生們設計自己的名片。

examples.en: She wants to design casual clothes for young people after finishing art school.
examples.zh: 她希望從藝術學校畢業後能為年輕人設計休閒服飾。

examples.en: Software engineers must design an intuitive user interface to enhance customer retention.
examples.zh: 軟體工程師必須設計直覺易用的人機介面，以提高客戶留存率。

examples.en: The modern civic center was carefully designed to minimize energy consumption and rainwater runoff.
examples.zh: 這座現代市民中心經過悉心設計，能最大程度降低能耗與雨水逕流。

examples.en: Architects meticulously design resilient structural frameworks capable of dissipating high-magnitude seismic forces.
examples.zh: 建築師精細設計具韌性的結構框架，使其具備耗散強烈地震能量的能力。

examples.en: Let's position the chairs over there so that everyone can sit and watch the magic show.
examples.zh: 我們把椅子擺放去那邊，這樣大家都能坐下來看魔術表演。

examples.en: Position the indoor plant near the window where it can receive enough sunlight.
examples.zh: 把室內盆栽放在窗戶附近，讓它能接受充足的日照。

examples.en: The marketing department decided to position the new drink as a premium wellness beverage.
examples.zh: 行銷部門決定將這款新飲品定位為高端健康養生飲品。

examples.en: The company positioned surveillance cameras across the warehouse to prevent product loss.
examples.zh: 公司在整個倉庫各處安裝架設監視器，以防止貨物失竊。

examples.en: Strategic enterprises deliberately position proprietary patents across niche sectors to secure competitive leverage.
examples.zh: 具策略遠見的企業刻意在利基領域佈局專利資產，以掌握競爭制衡優勢。

examples.en: My mother likes this particular shampoo. We can't buy just any brand.
examples.zh: 我媽媽只喜歡這款特定的洗髮精，我們不能隨便買任何品牌。

examples.en: Is there any particular movie you would like to watch at the cinema tonight?
examples.zh: 今晚去電影院，你有沒有特別想看哪一部電影？

examples.en: She paid particular attention to the pronunciation rules taught during the grammar workshop.
examples.zh: 她對文法工作坊講授的發音規則特別留心注意。

examples.en: He is very particular about his coffee beans and insists on grinding them fresh every morning.
examples.zh: 他對咖啡豆非常講究挑剔，堅持每天早上現磨新鮮咖啡豆。

examples.en: Executing molecular biotechnology synthesis requires meticulous alignment with particular biochemical parameters.
examples.zh: 執行分子生物技術合成必須嚴格遵循特定的生物化學反應參數。

examples.en: Beethoven continued to create music even after his hearing problem became more serious.
examples.zh: 即使在聽力問題日益嚴重之後，貝多芬仍持續創作音樂。

examples.en: Children use building blocks and paper clay to create wonderful small houses.
examples.zh: 孩子們用積木和紙黏土創造出很棒的小房子。

examples.en: The government launched new loan programs to help young entrepreneurs create startup jobs.
examples.zh: 政府推出了新的青年貸款方案，協助青年創業家創造新創職缺。

examples.en: A positive work atmosphere helps create stronger collaboration among cross-functional teams.
examples.zh: 良好的工作氛圍有助於在跨職能團隊之間營造更緊密的協同合作。

examples.en: Pioneering cloud computing architectures create exponential efficiency gains for distributed corporate operations.
examples.zh: 開創性的雲端運算架構為跨國分散式企業營運帶來了指數級的效率提升。

examples.en: When we encounter a problem, we should calm down and look for a solution.
examples.zh: 當我們遇到問題時，應該冷靜下來並尋找解決方案。

examples.en: Tourists may encounter heavy traffic delays near the scenic spots over the long weekend.
examples.zh: 連假期間，觀光客在風景名勝區附近可能會遇到嚴重的交通壅塞。

examples.en: Foreign travelers often encounter cultural differences when ordering food in traditional markets.
examples.zh: 外國旅客在傳統市場點餐時，經常會遇到文化差異的情況。

examples.en: The software engineers encountered unexpected runtime exceptions during the database migration phase.
examples.zh: 軟體工程師在資料庫轉移階段遭遇了意料之外的運行時錯誤例外。

examples.en: Multinational corporations frequently encounter intricate cross-border antitrust and tariff compliance hurdles.
examples.zh: 跨國公司在海外業務拓展中經常面臨錯綜複雜的跨境反壟斷與關稅合規障礙。

examples.en: We should go to bed now because we need to wake up early in the morning to watch the sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們現在該去睡覺了，因為明早我們需要早起看日出。

examples.en: I usually wake up around seven o'clock on weekdays without needing an alarm clock.
examples.zh: 平日我通常七點左右就會醒來，甚至不需要鬧鐘。

examples.en: A cup of strong black coffee helps him wake up and prepare for the morning briefing.
examples.zh: 一杯濃郁的黑咖啡能幫助他提神醒腦，為早晨簡報做好準備。

examples.en: The loud noise outside caused the sleeping baby to wake up crying in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 屋外巨大的噪音導致熟睡中的小嬰兒半夜驚醒哭了起來。

examples.en: Global economic shocks abruptly woke up institutional investors to the latent liquidity hazards of overleveraged portfolios.
examples.zh: 全球經濟動盪猛然讓機構投資者清醒意識到高槓桿投資組合所潛藏的流動性危機。

examples.en: The firefighters took action right away to save the people from the burning house.
examples.zh: 消防隊員們立刻採取行動，從燃燒的房子中把人們救出。

examples.en: We need to take action before the heavy rain causes flooding in our neighborhood.
examples.zh: 我們必須在大雨引發社區淹水之前採取行動。

examples.en: The school took immediate disciplinary action against students who engaged in bullying.
examples.zh: 學校針對參與霸凌行為的學生立即採取了紀律處分行動。

examples.en: Governments worldwide must take concrete action to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and safeguard the planet.
examples.zh: 全球各國政府必須採取具體行動以降低溫室氣體排放並保護地球。

examples.en: Regulatory compliance committees must decisively take prompt corrective action upon detecting fiduciary irregularities.
examples.zh: 法規遵從委員會在查覺信託違規徵兆時，必須果斷迅速採取補救懲處行動。

examples.en: My family is going to get out of town for a vacation next week.
examples.zh: 下星期我家人將要離城去度假。

examples.en: Please get out of the vehicle carefully because oncoming traffic is fast.
examples.zh: 下車時請格外小心，因為迎面而來的車速很快。

examples.en: He made up an excuse to get out of attending the boring after-work dinner.
examples.zh: 他編造了一個藉口，好藉此擺脫參加下班後枯燥的應酬聚餐。

examples.en: Taking a brisk morning walk helps employees get out of a midday creative slump.
examples.zh: 早晨快走散步有助於上班族擺脫午後的靈感枯竭與創意低潮。

examples.en: Emerging economies struggle to get out of entrenched structural middle-income traps without sustained technological upgrading.
examples.zh: 新興經濟體若無持續的技術升級，極難擺脫根深蒂固的結構性中等收入陷阱。

examples.en: Please hand in your homework on time.
examples.zh: 請準時交作業。

examples.en: The commuter train arrived at the central station exactly on time this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨通勤火車準時抵達中央車站。

examples.en: She managed to submit the detailed budget proposal on time despite the tight deadline.
examples.zh: 儘管截止期限緊迫，她依然成功準時呈交了詳盡的預算提案。

examples.en: Clients appreciate logistics suppliers that consistently deliver commercial shipments on time.
examples.zh: 客戶非常讚許能始終如一準時送達商業貨件的物流供應商。

examples.en: Executing large-scale infrastructural procurement on time and within budget remains a hallmark of engineering excellence.
examples.zh: 如期且在預算範圍內落實大型基礎設施採購專案，始終是卓越工程管理的重要標竿。

examples.en: All the students and teachers went outside when the fire alarm in the school went off.
examples.zh: 學校裡的火災警鈴響起時，所有的學生與老師們都到戶外去。

examples.en: My phone alarm goes off at seven every morning.
examples.zh: 我的手機鬧鐘每天早上七點整響起。

examples.en: The burglar alarm went off accidentally when the strong wind blew open the front door.
examples.zh: 當強風吹開大門時，防盜警報器意外被觸發響起。

examples.en: If smoke detectors go off inside the hotel, guests are advised to evacuate immediately via the emergency stairs.
examples.zh: 若飯店內部煙霧探測器警鈴大作，建議房客立即經由緊急逃生梯疏散撤離。

examples.en: Industrial facility monitoring failsafes automatically trigger siren alarms to go off if volatile gas levels exceed thresholds.
examples.zh: 工業設施監控容錯機制在揮發性氣體濃度超標時，會自動觸發警報汽笛作響。

examples.en: Remember to take your medicine three times a day in order to get well soon.
examples.zh: 記得一天服藥三次以早日康復。

examples.en: She left home early in order to catch the first bus into the city.
examples.zh: 她很早就出門，為了趕上開往市區的頭班公車。

examples.en: He studied for additional hours every evening in order to pass the competitive civil service entrance exam.
examples.zh: 他每天晚上多花幾小時唸書，為了通過競爭激烈的公職招考。

examples.en: The airline upgraded its booking platform in order to provide travelers with a smoother reservation experience.
examples.zh: 該航空公司升級了訂票平台，旨在為旅客提供更流暢的預訂體驗。

examples.en: Conglomerates aggressively optimize supply chains in order to sustain operating margins amidst severe inflationary headwind.
examples.zh: 企業集團積極優化供應鏈體系，以期在嚴峻的通膨逆風中穩固營運毛利率。

examples.en: Kelly thought the restaurant would be busy, so she booked a table in advance.
examples.zh: Kelly 認為那家餐廳會很忙碌，所以她事先預訂了一桌。

examples.en: You can get cheaper high-speed rail tickets if you purchase them two weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 如果你提前兩週預購，就能買到更優惠的高鐵車票。

examples.en: Please notify the human resources department in advance if you plan to take annual leave next month.
examples.zh: 若你打算下個月休年假，請務必事先告知人力資源部門。

examples.en: The speaker distributed the technical workshop materials to attendees in advance of the lecture.
examples.zh: 主講人在演講開始前，已事先將技術工作坊資料發放給與會者。

examples.en: Corporate treasurers hedge foreign currency exposures quarters in advance to neutralize prospective exchange rate fluctuations.
examples.zh: 企業財務主管會提前數季進行外幣避險對沖，以抵消未來的匯率波動風險。
